description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki Cushions & Pads that go between the Body and the Frame
Includes All Metal Parts plus Bolts, Nuts & Washers
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 6 Cushions, Lower Mount
Qty 6 Cushions, Upper Mount
Qty 2 Pads, Body Mount #4 B
Qty 2 Pads, Body Mount #4 A
Qty 2 Pads, Body Mount #1
Qty 16 Pads, Body Mount #2
Qty 6 – (Metal) Bottom, Body Mounts
Qty 6 – (Metal) Nuts, Body Mount
Qty 4 – (Metal) Bolts, 1st Mount (2) & 4th Mount (2)
Qty 4 – (Metal) Washers, 1st Mount (2) & 4th Mount (2)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
